Choose whether to place it standing and use it as a shelving unit or lying and use it as a sideboard. This furniture can take a max load of 55 lbs. on the top.
ldJson.name: KALLAX Shelf unit - white 30 1/8x57 5/8 "

review.name: Little lighter than expected
review.reviewBody: I feel its a little less sturdy than the one in the showroom. Otherwise excellent

review.name: Great unit
review.reviewBody: Best cube shelf unit, I have 4 of them from ikea and I have purchased a similar cube unit from other places. But, the IKEA ones are 100 percent better than all of the other cube units out there.

review.name: Easy to put together great for my space,  but...
review.reviewBody: I do love these, especially the range of accessories,  but wish they still sold the  casters for them.  I have them on the the 8cube I have, they make it so easy to move to clean behind or to recover lost pet toys especially when you live alone, now if I want another unit next to the one I already have the height won't match and it'll look off to me,  please Ikea bring back the wheels!

review.name: Looking for Brown
review.reviewBody: Too dark looking for basic med brown

review.name: I bought it again
review.reviewBody: Bought the first for a toddler bookshelf (horizontal, low, sturdy).  Fast forward a decade and bought another for the same kid as a teen needing more storage/extended desk surface.  Easy to assemble, fair price, sturdy, and looks way better than the flimsy versions found at other box stores.  My kid is NOT easy on anything, but you would never know that one is so much older than the other.  Quality affordable product.

review.name: The 2x4 works better in the long run
review.reviewBody: I needed a 4x4 unit, but then realized it might make more sense to buy (2) 2x4 units. I can move them later if my decor changes. Another bonus of two units, I won't have to worry about a middle shelf sag. I have the vertically placed side by side.

review.name: Practical and easy assembly !
review.reviewBody: It’s like a custom-made unit into an oddly shaped closet. Perfect for clothes hats, socks mittens, perfectly fitting the linen baskets that fit perfectly within the squares.

review.name: Great shelves unit
review.reviewBody: This shelving unit was easy to put together and fit perfectly in the space I needed the baskets hold a lot of items.

review.name: This is fantastic
review.reviewBody: I needed to get rid of a large table that had become a clutter catcher.  This self system solved all my issues.  Over flow records that don't fit in the record cabinet, games, books... all fit in this unit. this is an absolute life saver

review.name: Amazing product
review.reviewBody: Easy to put together amazing product keeps all my toddlers toys organized

review.name: KALLAX
review.reviewBody: I love this unit! The only regret is that I should have bought a much larger one!

review.name: Best Buy Ever
review.reviewBody: Easy to put together. Great quality! Great price!  I have purchased several of these over the years. For my bedroom and for the living room! They still look great. The storage bins holds a lot of stuff. Though, the selection of storage bins has dwindled down the shelf itself is great.

review.name: Very handy shelf unit
review.reviewBody: Versatile, easy to assemble, sturdy shelving unit.

review.name: Good quality
review.reviewBody: Very good quality. Easy to assemble. Sturdy piece of furniture.

review.name: A classic
review.reviewBody: Such an iconic and versatile piece.  We love it!

review.name: A Go-To piece
review.reviewBody: I have seven pieces of varying sizes in my apartment. They are very versatile and pleasing.

review.name: So useful and look great
review.reviewBody: I have a couple of these and they are so useful for storage. They look really nice too and are very sturdy. My daughter liked them so much she got a couple for her daughter's playroom!

review.name: Love These
review.reviewBody: this is my third set of these in different houses.  Nothing can beat the versatility and storage room.

review.name: Great unit, but inserts with doors are dealbreaker
review.reviewBody: If you are looking to use the shelving unit on its own, it's great. However if you are planning to add any wooden inserts with doors, be sure you read the reviews on the inserts before proceeding as they're terrible. Had I read the review on the inserts (which I thought was a minor deal) I definitely would not have purchased the Kallax but now it's fully assembled in my living room and I'm dreading fully un-assembling and returning. It's a shame because the kallax itself is nice, it's the system that's not.

review.name: I got the oak stained color
review.reviewBody: I love the combination of Oak stained shelf unit (I use mine horizontally ) with the natural colored Baskets. I added, later two doors. love i,, love it.
